It's finally here!  The long-awaited [b]Voice Acting Update![/b]

Limited voice-acting has been added for [b]all major characters[/b] in Champion of Venus. It's like a feast for your ear-holes!

[b]- Kamila Bombette[/b] - Rayne/Tayla/Nenet.
[b]- BakuSatsuHo[/b] - Venus/Militsa.
[b]- Bordeaux Black[/b] - Inanna.
[b]- @UnderTheBurral[/b] - Goro.
[b]- Nami955[/b] - Gloria.
[b]- Opalu[/b] - Slimeboy/All-Thought.
[b]- Ferallove[/b] - Connie/Aik.
[b]- Lorian Loc[/b] - Lamashtu (both forms).


In addition, some [b]'ding'[/b] and [b]'whoosh!'[/b] sound effects have been added to emphasise certain story moments.

Also, I fixed a bug that caused one Aik scene not to appear in the Gallery.

Enjoy, you saucy players, you!

notes.title: Champion of Venus - Full Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/f86f6675e34155c9cacd34e09d5fc0052efa7dd4.png[/img]


Wow.

After four years of development, it's finally come to fruition - [b]Champion of Venus is HERE![/b]

I'd like to take this time to thank everyone who's supported the development process. Every artist, composer, voice actor, and player - you've all been wonderful.

So, once and for old times' sake, here goes:

--

[i]Champion of Venus is an erotic visual novel about a virgin NEET and a divine sex tournament. Chosen as the accidental champion of a lust goddess, Rayne must compete with some of the world's most experienced studs and seductresses...and somehow come out on top?

Strive, champion, for the world could be your prize...and the price of failure is eternal servitude.[/i]

--

...Phew!

Here's a list of features new to 1.0:


[u][b]Ero Scene CGs.[/b][/u]

-	Goro shows off his sausage.
-	Revamped Goro’s bout.
-	All-Thought mating press.
-	Lamashtu vs Goro Part 2.
-	Finished Rayne vore scene.
-	Militsa intro.
-	Rayne’s twerking scene (during Gloria’s Bad End).
-	Nenet vs tentacles.
-	Shin Inanna and Venus Victrix transformation scenes.



[u][b]Non-Ero CGs.[/b][/u]

-	SCHLONG raids the penthouse.
-	Rayne discovering Tayla at the penthouse.
-	Tayla corrupted.

[u][b]Backgrounds.[/b][/u]

-	Orgy at the club.
-	Tentacle backgrounds.
-	Multiple backgrounds for the vore route.
-	Elevator background.
-	Club hallway background.
-	A background for when Rayne is reviewing SCHLONG’s files.
-	Club background for Goro and Aik’s show.

[u][b]Sprites.[/b][/u]

-	Improved All-Thought sprites, added more expressions.
-	SCHLONG agent sprites (male and female).
-	Roberta, the girl in the gym, has a sprite now.
-	‘Aik with shovel’ sprite.


[u][b]Other features.[/b][/u]

-	Fully revamped the [b]Art Gallery.[/b] Stopped being a doofus and used Ren’Py’s built-in Gallery function. The Gallery is now available from the start, with scenes unlocking as you reach them in the main story.
-	The Character Compendium remains in its current form.
-	Bad Ends now offer the option to return to the main thread, instead of automatically rolling the credits.


[u][b]
Voice-Acting.[/b][/u]

-	Added “Champion of Venus!” voice clips to the title screen. 


[u][b]Misc.[/b][/u]

-	Many, many, [i]many[/i] changes to the text, transitions etc.


--

[h1][b]
Due to the multitude of changes, your existing save will probably break.[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Getting Ready for Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/f86f6675e34155c9cacd34e09d5fc0052efa7dd4.png[/img]

Hoo boy...

After four years of development, including one year in Early Access, it's finally just a few days away: 

[b]Champion of Venus hits 1.0 on April 18th![/b]

It's been a long, creatively satisfying road, and we can't wait to share the final product!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/f76a44b37c1f0d2c7581c7a38e4da42160aa569e.png[/img]

[b][h1]What is Champion of Venus?[/h1][/b]

Champion of Venus is a lewd visual novel about a divine sex tournament. 

When [b]Rayne[/b], a virgin nerd, is made the champion of the goddess Venus, she must learn to stand on her own two feet...or become the plaything of the world's most powerful perverts.

Forge alliances, rivalries, and romances as you strive for the ultimate prize: to sit the [b]Throne of Eros.[/b]

-

Champion of Venus features over 600 pictures (almost [b]double[/b] the pre-Early Access total), 11 music tracks, and 13 [b]smokin' hot[/b] characters to conquer or be conquered by - spread over 12 chapters of pure obscenity. 

[b]Artists include:[/b] Octoboy, Sulcate, Sparrow, Captain Kirb, TheBoogie, Seekgr, BigBig, xxxx52, Lemonfont, Kainan, Onkenyo, and Crotchlunch.

[h2]Other features.[/h2]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/ad8635dcd21d9c9cfd16c3a21b22bc3f39fef1a9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/6b46871d2a65d0d10fc1bc9601fd0aa66a617d85.png[/img]


Howdy all, and welcome to the grand unveiling of [b]Champion of Venus – Version 0.8![/b]

This update’s particularly special. Besides bringing [b][i]more new content than ever before[/i][/b], it also brings the main story to a thrilling climax - or multiple climaxes, as the case may be.

Here's a full list of new stuff!


[h2][u][b]Story.[/b][/u][/h2]

- [b]Chapter 12[/b] is now complete, featuring 9 brand-new ero scenes.
- Extended Lamashtu's Bad End with a new CG.


[h2][u][b]Ero CGs.[/b][/u][/h2]

-	[b]Goro Introduction Scene (Goro’s self-pleasure show)[/b] by Octoboy.
-	[b]Lamashtu Bad End Part 2 – Goro Gets Holstered[/b] by Octoboy.
-	[b]New character ahegao CG[/b] by Octoboy.
-	[b]Big Rayne Transformation[/b] by Octoboy.
-	[b]Goro Harem Scene[/b] by Captain Kirb.
-	[b]Nenet Harem Scene[/b] by Captain Kirb.
-	[b]Goro/Nenet Harem Scene[/b] by Captain Kirb
-	[b]Throne Bang[/b] by Captain Kirb.
-	[b]Ultimate Bad Ending[/b] by Seekgr.
-	[b]Ultimate Bad Ending (Vore)[/b] by Seekgr.
-	[b]Goro’s Bad Ending[/b] by Lemonfont.
-	[b]Rayne vs Aik[/b] by Lemonfont.
-	[b]Rayne vs Lamashtu pt 2[/b] by Theboogie.
-	[b]Secret Final Vore Scene[/b] by Theboogie. (unfinished - just a sketch at the moment!)
-	[b]Rayne and the Jar[/b] by Sparrow.

[h2][u][b]Non-Ero CGs.[/b][/u][/h2]

-	Rats and donuts.
-	Rat in the vents (sus).
-	Slime in the vents.
-	Lammy in the vents.
-	Venus’s Portal.
-	Rayne & Tayla city escape (animated by Erismanor!)
-	The Final Battle.
-	The Throne itself.
-	Pink fog/love heart effect for romantic scenes.
-	Inanna's very un-poggers day.

[h2][u][b]Backgrounds.[/b][/u][/h2]

-	Character-specific backgrounds for Nenet, Goro, Militsa, and Connie.
-	Desert background.
-	Portal background.
-	Animated swirling mist.
-	The Throne of Eros.
-       Ideal Form animated background.

[h2][u][b]Sprites.[/b][/u][/h2]

-	Several new character sprites. Most of them are rats, but one's a [b]mysterious new character[/b]...

[h2][u][b]Music.[/b][/u][/h2]

-	A cheery new music track from Sometimescozy!

[h2][u][b]Trailer.[/b][/u][/h2]

What, a new trailer? Cool! It's up on the Steam page now!


[h2][u][b]Update Discount.[/b][/u][/h2]

Huh?? Discount?? Money??

That's right! From now until the 3rd of March, Champion of Venus will be [b]20% off[/b] on Steam!

[h1][u][b]Final Release Date:[/b][/u][/h1]

Now's a good time to announce that, exactly 1 year after entering Early Access...

[b]...Champion of Venus will fully release on [u]April 18th, 2023![/u][/b] 

By then, after a long period of polishing and adding lots of little bits I couldn't get to until now, I'll be happy to call the game 'complete'...

...But that doesn't mean more features won't be coming post-launch. Look forward to [b][i]voice-acting[/i][/b] being added in a post-1.0 update!

[h2]Planned Price Change.[/h2]

Whew! The last year's been a lot of work, and thanks to Early Access (and the help of the wonderful, talented Octoboy), I've been able to add more features than I ever dreamed possible.

Champion of Venus has grown into a much larger game than originally intended. For that reason, when 1.0 launches on April 18th, I'll be [b]raising the store price[/b] from $5.99 to [b]$6.99![/b] 

It's just a coincidence that it's almost the funny sex number.

Version 0.7.1 is, like, totally here! So, you know...like, check it out and stuff!


[u][b]New Features.[/b][/u]

-	Added an [b]Art Gallery and Character Compendium[/b], where you can view all the ero illustrations in the game and read info and fun facts about the characters. These features unlock once you’ve finished all currently-playable story content.

-	Outside Club Desires (plus variations).

…All this means that the generic ‘city’ background is no longer used for all outdoor scenes! Hooray, variety!

Happy holidays, you filthy animals.

notes.title: Version 0.7 - Prison of Souls
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/b4b82aef3dd1888807af2c0cd34629fcca07d6b4.png[/img]

Attention all CoV gamers: Rayne is in great danger and she needs YOUR help to fuck all the slimes in the Prison of Souls.

That's right - [b]Version 0.7[/b] is here, and of all updates, this one is by far the most recent.

It's also the [b]largest[/b]. Maybe I should have said that first? Featuring 20,000 words of fresh content, 9 new or revamped ero scenes, a swanky new music track, and a brand-spanking new font, Version 0.7 puts the "_____g _ _ud___" in "having a budget".

The new chapter is also kinda spooky, so...fitting for Halloween?

Here's a more detailed list of features!


[u][b]Story:[/b][/u]

- [b]Chapter 11: Prison of Souls[/b] has been added. In this chapter, Rayne and co. find themselves in an otherworldly prison; playthings of a cruel entity who calls herself the Demon Daughter. Can they escape in time, or will they become Lamashtu's eternal pets? Chapter 11 comprises over 20,000 words of new content, filled with more ero scenes than ever before.

- I've revamped the Aik/Rayne ero scene. Double buttjob, anyone? This may cause issues if you load a save halfway through the old scene.

- The Rayne/Militsa futa scene has also been altered. 


[u][b]Art:[/b][/u]

    2) Aik/Rayne Double Buttjob - Art by CaptainKirb.
    3) Rayne/Venus Bathroom Milk 'n' Fuck - Art by KiraLChocolate.

- 4 new character sprites!


[u][b]Backgrounds:[/b][/u]

- Chapter 11 features 2 new backgrounds.


[u][b]Music:[/b][/u]

- Chapter 11 features a new track by Blue Fairy.


[u][b]Misc:[/b][/u]

- Champion of Venus now uses the 'Patrick Hand' font.

Been a while, hasn't it?

This month - [b]October 21st[/b], to be precise - [u][b]Champion of Venus: Version 0.7[/b][/u] will release!

- [b]Chapter 11: Prison of Souls[/b] picks up with Rayne and co. trapped in their direst situation yet. Can they escape the clutches of Lamashtu, a demon unbound by the Tournament's rules?

Chapter 11 features [b]20,000 words of new content[/b], and lots of illustrated ero scenes with art by CaptainKirb, Octoboy, and Lemonfont.

notes.title: Champion of Venus - Version 0.6.1
notes.content:
That's right - it's time for a new update! No fancy intro this time; let's cut right to the chase.

In terms of new illustrations, Version 0.6.2 is the largest update so far, featuring works from the likes of [b]Octoboy, CaptainKirb, Lemonfont, and KiraLChocolate![/b] 


For a [b]detailed breakdown[/b] of new features, direct your eyes o'er yonder:




[u][b]New Scenes:[/b][/u]

- An alternate version of Rayne and Venus's milky bathtime adventure.

- An optional extension to Goro's romance scene, featuring an enlarged Rayne and a [i]very[/i] stretchy idol.


[u][b]Ero Illustrations:[/b][/u]

- A new, updated version of the game's [b]first ero scene[/b], featuring Rayne and one oversized toy.

- The scene where Rayne and Venus enjoy a tight, face-engulfing snuggle is now illustrated.

- [b]Venus vs the Lamia[/b] is now fully illustrated!

- Both of the new ero scenes are fully illustrated.

- Connie gets her moment in the spotlight! [b]Rayne and Connie's ero scene[/b] is now fully illustrated.


[u][b]Backgrounds:[/b][/u]

- Areas in and around the club are now illustrated: the [b]club interior[/b] has several backgrounds, and the alleyway [i]next[/i] to the club is no longer a black void.


[u][b]Other Art:[/b][/u]

- For those of you desperate to know what Rayne's phone looks like, now you can! Several [b]in-game items[/b] now appear on-screen. 

- Illustrations for [b]'BOUT START', 'VICTORY'[/b] etc now appear.

- The club bouncer now has a character sprite. How nice for him!

- In RAT END, King Tony now acquires a [b]crown[/b] more befitting his station.

- The [b]'intro cutscene' [/b]now has a special background.

[u][b]Misc:[/b][/u]


- The UI has received an upgrade! There are now [b]two seperate textboxes[/b]: one for dialogue, and one for prose.

- Many, MANY textual improvements have been made, with a focus on pauses and ease-of-reading.

notes.title: Version 0.6 - Eye of the Storm
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/41224fe7b96176cb7a61f11b5473983e6eac07b7.png[/img]


What's this? 


Oh my! It seems to be [i]your face[/i], while you enjoy Champion of Venus's [b]biggest update so far![/b]

Due to the hard work of talented artists, the mystical art of 'having a budget', and the massive surge of inspiration resulting from these two things, Version 0.6 has proven a greater step forward than I ever could have imagined. 

Look forward to new [b]character sprites[/b], new [b]ero scenes[/b], new [b]placeholder backgrounds[/b], and ridiculous amounts of [i]new-dity[/i] (get it?) as you delve into a tale of love, lust, and lecherous liaisons by moonlight.


Here's a [b]full breakdown[/b] of new content:


[u][b]Story:[/b][/u]

- [b]Chapter 10: Eye of the Storm.[/b] Following her victory against Gloria, Rayne's on top of the world - but the tournament isn't yet over, and Inanna still has cards left to play. Enjoy the peace while it lasts, tighten Rayne's bonds with her allies, and maybe...help her find love? You don't have long before it all falls apart...

- A new [b]ero scene[/b] featuring Rayne and Goro. During Chapter 10, pay him a visit and confess your feelings. Romance ahoy!

- A new ero scene featuring Rayne and Venus.

- A new [b]BAD END[/b] sequence: to view it, submit to Gloria during the big confrontation. 

- Edited Inanna’s meeting with ‘Miss Section Chief’ to better reflect the character.

- Added a scene introducing the [b]new character[/b] earlier in the game, during Rayne's infiltration of SCHLONG HQ.


[u][b]Art:[/b][/u]


- Added a character sprite for a [b]new character.[/b]

- Gave [b]Aik[/b] a character sprite, because she earned it.

- CGs by Octoboy for the new [b]Rayne/Goro ero scene[/b].

- CGs by KiraLChocolate for the new [b]BAD END[/b].

- CGs by Sparrow, upgrading Rayne, Nenet, and Venus’s [b]double-blowjob scene[/b].

- Added several [b]placeholder backgrounds[/b].

- Improved [b]Inanna eyes[/b] background.

- Improved several cut-in sprites.

- Improved rat sprites.


[u][b]Misc.:[/b][/u]

- Many, many dialogue tweaks and fixes.

- Improved credits sequence; it looks downright [b]fancy[/b] now.

- Pacing/transition adjustments across the board.


[u][b]Rats:[/b][/u]

- Improved rats. Honestly, this should be at the top of the list.

- Yes, you read right: [i]rats,[/i] plural. There are two of them now. How far can this silly joke go? Only time may tell.

notes.title: What's Coming in Version 0.6?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/93023301762b9f04f1c8ad50569cf4bc5d8f8a34.png[/img]


Eyy.

Time sure is subjective, huh? [b]Version 0.5.2[/b] only just released, bringing with it animations, music, and backgrounds, but it feels like a much longer amount of time has passed.

I've been, as they say, [i]bizzay.[/i]

[b]Version 0.6[/b] will be Champion of Venus's biggest update yet, bringing a new chapter, new ero scenes (plus improvements to older ones), new character sprites, and a brand-new rat. 

Here's a [b]breakdown[/b] of what I've implemented so far, though it's by no means the full extent of what's coming:


[u][b]Story:[/b][/u]

- [b]Chapter 10: Eye of the Storm.[/b] Following her victory against Gloria, Rayne's on top of the world - but the tournament isn't over yet, and Inanna still has cards left to play. Enjoy the peace while it lasts, tighten Rayne's bonds with her allies, and maybe...help her find love? You don't have long before it all falls apart...

- A new [b]ero scene[/b] featuring Rayne and Goro. During Chapter 10, pay him a visit and confess your feelings.

- A new [b]BAD END[/b] sequence: to view it, submit to Gloria during the big confrontation. 

- Edited Inanna’s meeting with ‘Miss Section Chief’ to better reflect the character.


[u][b]Art:[/b][/u]

- CGs by KiraLChocolate for the new [b]BAD END[/b].

- CGs by Octoboy for the new [b]Rayne/Goro ero scene[/b].

- CGs by Sparrow, upgrading Rayne, Nenet, and Venus’s [b]double-blowjob scene[/b].

- Added tons of [b]placeholder art[/b].

- Gave Aik a [b]character sprite[/b]. She's earned it.

- Improved [b]Inanna eyes[/b] background.

- Improved rat sprites.


[u][b]Misc.:[/b][/u]

- Improved credits sequence; it looks downright [i][b]fancy[/b][/i] now.

- General dialogue tweaks and fixes.


[u][b]Rats:[/b][/u]







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/4c971e42b6bed6f69ade3f77d80a7f926ea138ed.png[/img]


That's right! You voted, and I listened - [b]Rollatini[/b] is joining the cast! He's a little shy, so give him a warm welcome.

You can unlock rat content by looking behind SCHLONG HQ after you first meet Connie.




---


You can expect Version 0.6 to release sometime in [b]mid to late July[/b]. Look forward to it!

notes.title: Champion of Venus - Update Coming Early June!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42197326/5d3b0c4cd0a3825c4d336d67042dead94147c222.png[/img]


It's been exactly one month since Champion of Venus released into Early Access, and over 1,500 copies have been sold! To say this is like a dream would be an understatement, so thank you for all your support so far!

I just wanna let you know that an update is dropping in [b]early June 2022![/b] Here's what I've been working on:

[b]Art:[/b]

- 2 early ero scenes (Rayne/Venus, Rayne/Nenet) have received the animation treatment.

- No more black and white! Rayne's bout with Goro has been fully coloured.

- ...And following that trend, city/outdoor scenes have a proper background! 

[b]Music:[/b]

- Added a new music theme, dedicated to the giant rat who makes ALL of the rules.

[b]Misc:[/b]

- Edited BAD END and CHAPTER END cards to be a little fancier.

- Edited RAT END to automatically return you to the main thread. 


...And there's [b]more to come![/b] 

I've been focusing on your input regarding placeholder art and incomplete-ness, so this update will mainly be addressing that. Other than that, I've spent a lot of time brainstorming how [b]Act 3[/b] will play out. 

Oh, you want a hint? Well, if you insist...




[i]The villain might be on the backfoot, but she's not out - not by a long shot. Her ace in the hole - her trap card, if you will - is about to be activated. 

If she can't have what she wants, then her enemies can go straight to Hell.[/i]




So, stay tuned for [i]that[/i] lewdness.
